replication_quota_rule: external study host must freeze an integer replication quota >=1 for each of the three strata, plus their sum replication_target_n, before candidate predictions; this protocol does not invent those quotas
allocation_key: SHA256('A6-ALLOCATION-V1|' + stratum + '|' + packet_id + '|' + source_family_id + '|' + normalized_organization_lineage + '|' + artifact_lineage_id)
algorithm: validate that replication_target_n and exact per-stratum replication quotas are frozen before candidate predictions and sum exactly
within each stratum sort eligible packets by allocation_key ascending then packet_id
continue scanning and select the externally frozen replication quota for that stratum
source_family_id, normalized_organization_lineage and artifact_lineage_id must be unique across all selected primary and replication packets
do not move replication quota across strata after outcomes
shortfall is CANNOT_CHECK, not a reason to change replication N or substitute another stratum
